run_replace_clip_weights: run the script to replace CLIP weights in an OVSeg model checkpoint with finetuned CLIP checkpoint weights
run_strip_module_prefix: run the script to strip the module prefix from a PyTorch state dict loaded from a DDP checkpoint
run_update_ovseg_clip_adapter: run the script to update the clip_adapter.clip_model keys in an OVSeg checkpoint with new CLIP weights
run_check_mask_embedding: run the script to check if a CLIP checkpoint contains a mask_embedding tensor for mask prompt tuning
run_save_updated_ovseg: run the script to save an updated OVSeg model checkpoint with replaced CLIP weights to a new path
